description:
Title                       : Sr. PeopleSoft Portal Developer 
 Location               : New York. 
 Duration               : Full Time. 
 Salary                    : $100K+Benefits+Relocation 
   
 PeopleSoft  Portal Senior Developer 
   
 •        Strong PeopleSoft technical knowledge (i.e. SQR, App Engine, Component Interface, Messaging, Security, Online objects, etc…).
 •        Desirable with Java Skills or Ability to Learn to support other in-house Java Applications. 
 •        PeopleSoft Portal  Development, Upgrade and Testing experience is key to this role preferably with experience in Java to trouble shoot Portal and Java Applications which is customized in GE. 
 •        Ability to write a technical Spec from a functional spec .
 •        Ability to communicate and Q/A with the functional design architects 
 •        Experience includes multiple full life cycle implementations
 •        Ability to conceptualize a wing to wing design based on an understanding of requirements and Technical expertise in the PeopleSoft Portal 
 •        Ability to review functional specs for completeness and identify gaps along with potential downstream or parallel implications. 
 •        Ability to come up with multiple alternate designs based on an understanding of the larger picture, product limitations and operational supportability .
 •        Ability to mentor and pass on skills.
